name: Secret of the Circle
label: Quest
description: Secret of the Circle: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My memories are cloudy, but I will tell you what I can. The circle of statues in the Sunken Temple, while dangerous, I believe that they hold the secret to unlock an even greater treasure.
From the main altar, I was able to activate a series of lights. I think that if you can uncover what these lights mean, you might be able to unlock whatever secrets are hiding in this room.
I warn you though, friend. Great evil lies in the temple. It's likely that anything valuable will be fervently guarded...

clips.title: Completion
paras: The eye of the idol glitters brightly even in the half-darkness of the temple. Its transparency reveals something shiny behind it. Sliding it to the side, you reach in and grasp what lies inside the statue.
The Atal'ai treasure is now yours.
